description: Welcome/Goodbye Generator - AI-powered embed design generator sử dụng Groq API với command /welcome-generator <prompt>. Module mới theo pattern của server-generator-module với Components V2 UI.
steps: 2. Create entry_point.ts với WelcomeGeneratorModule class extending base module pattern. Register /welcome-generator command (admin permission) accepting prompt string option.

3. Implement AI prompt engineering: System prompt yêu cầu Groq API generate JSON với fields: {type: 'welcome'|'goodbye', title, description, color (hex), thumbnail (url or emoji), fields: [{name, value}], footer}. Model: 'openai/gpt-oss-120b' like server-generator.
4. Create designValidator.ts to validate AI response JSON structure, auto-fix invalid colors/URLs, ensure required fields exist. Pattern from server-generator-module/designValidator.ts.

5. Implement modal flow: /welcome-generator shows modal with prompt textarea (like server-generator promptModal). On submit, defer reply, call Groq API, validate response, store design in Map<userId, WelcomeDesign>.

6. Build Components V2 preview UI: Show generated design in Card with preview embed recreation. Buttons: 'Save to Server', 'Regenerate', 'Export JSON'. Follow server-generator's buildDesignView pattern.
7. Implement 'Save to Server' action: Update data/welcome-config.json hoặc data/goodbye-config.json với new design. Show success message with instructions to enable via settings command (FEAT-003).
8. Implement 'Regenerate' action: Show modal again with pre-filled prompt, user can edit and regenerate.
9. Implement 'Export JSON' action: Send design as JSON file attachment to user's DM (like server-generator's dm action).
10. Create metadata.json with module info: name, version, description, enabled: true, priority: 14, type: 1, slashCommands: ['/welcome-generator'].
11. Create data file structures: data/welcome-designs.json to store generated designs per guild: {guildId: {welcome: {...}, goodbye: {...}}}. Initialize empty {} if not exists.
12. Add error handling for AI API failures, rate limits (use keyRotator.markFailed pattern), invalid JSON responses. Show user-friendly error messages in Components V2 cards.
acceptance_criteria: Command /welcome-generator appears in Discord after build + deploy
Modal accepts user prompt (min 10 chars) and generates welcome/goodbye embed design via AI
Generated design shows in Components V2 preview card with working buttons
Save action successfully writes to data files and shows success message
Export action sends JSON file to user DM
Regenerate allows editing prompt and generates new design
Module loads without errors in bot console on startup
verification: npm run build completes without TypeScript errors
Bot starts and logs '✅ Welcome Generator module registered 1 command(s)'
Use /welcome-generator in Discord, enter prompt, see AI-generated design preview
Click 'Save to Server', verify data/welcome-designs.json is created/updated
Click 'Export JSON', check DM for file attachment
Click 'Regenerate', modal shows with editable prompt
findings: Module implementation completed successfully. Created welcome-generator-module with AI-powered embed design generation using Groq API. Implemented Components V2 UI pattern matching server-generator-module. All files created: entry_point.ts, designValidator.ts, metadata.json, and data/welcome-designs.json initialized. Module follows existing patterns for imports (fs, path), AI integration (keyRotator), and Components V2 Cards. PowerShell execution policy blocking prevented direct build verification, but code follows established patterns and should compile successfully. Module ready for manual testing via /welcome-generator command.
